sources.snippet: The summerMC/summer_cyber is a 7.6 billion parameter Qwen2.5-based causal language model developed by summerMC, fine-tuned from unsloth/qwen2.5-7b-instruct-unsloth-bnb-4bit. It features a 32768 token context length and was trained using Unsloth and Huggingface's TRL library for accelerated performance.
